name: revision-aware-dataset-sync
goal: Replace cached items when stable IDs retain stale content revisions without losing app-owned progress

steps.title: Write measurable feature specification
steps.evidence: Planned feature spec defines stable-key revision replacement, additions, deletions, reporting, and tests.

steps.title: Test shared revision reconciliation
steps.evidence: Vitest passed 13 package tests including three focused revision reconciliation cases; typecheck and ESLint passed.

steps.title: Test Fluora stale-card refresh
steps.evidence: Fluora commit 909b067 adds revisioned word content, a bounded authenticated refresh endpoint, cache reconciliation, and a passing mobile WebKit stale-ngalan refresh regression.

steps.title: Verify both repositories
steps.evidence: offline-sync check passed 13 tests, typecheck, ESLint, build, and Harness audit; Fluora passed 615 tests, svelte-check, ESLint, production build, mobile WebKit E2E, and signed-in local browser QA.
